verdict.rationale: Factory documents delegating a task and then reviewing the diff and merging from the App or terminal (factory-docs-1). It also documents remote delegation from Linear and Jira issues, where Droid implements and tests the work (factory-docs-36, factory-docs-37), and headless droid exec for CI/CD pipelines (factory-docs-41). This implies a merge-oriented workflow, but no evidence explicitly says Droid opens a pull request, let alone that this can be configured to happen automatically on task completion. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic PR creation on task completion, a configuration setting or trigger for it, details of the git provider integration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
